legal.risk.1: If the installation or an update is interrupted (cable unplugged, power cut, computer going to sleep) or if the firmware has a defect, the speaker may stop working. A recovery procedure exists, but it does not succeed in every case.
legal.risk.2: A firmware defect or a wrong setting can produce abnormal, loud or distorted sound. The protection limiter stays active, but it cannot cover every defect. Keep the volume moderate during your first tries.
legal.risk.3: This profile approximates the factory setting. It is not identical to the sound of the Bose® firmware.
legal.risk.4: A failure caused by OpenCompanion or by its installation may not be covered, neither by Bose® nor by your seller. Bose® provides no support for this firmware.
legal.risk.5: You can go back to the original firmware from Settings > Advanced > Original firmware <to be confirmed: exact location and whether it requires a backup made at installation>. The profiles stored in the speaker are then erased.
legal.risk.5.lead: Going back to the Bose® firmware.
legal.risk.p: OpenCompanion replaces your speaker's original firmware with an unofficial firmware that was neither designed nor tested by Bose®. You install it at your own risk.
